title: TaskCancelledData
description: Data of the task.cancelled event: the task in the event envelope was cancelled and released its worktree.

node.description: Node the task was cancelled at; finish if its scenario was passed.

reason.description: Why the task was cancelled; absent if not given.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree the task released.

source.description: Who did it: operator or agent.
